description: Returns a booking by its id and token (from create_booking), or its manageUrl passed as both, with `changeableUntil`, `refundableUntil`, `canCancel` and `cancelReasonRequired`. For a series, `series` lists every meeting with its own manageUrl.

id.description: the booking id from create_booking, or its manageUrl

token.description: the token from create_booking, or the manageUrl

name: get_booking
title: View a booking (invitee)
